blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — Two Negrenses who were recently named National Artists will be honored as this year’s Outstanding Negrenses at the Cinco de Noviembre rites at the Social Hall of the Provincial Capitol in Bacolod City on Thursday, Nov. 5, in commemoration of the 128th year after the Negrense revolt. President Marcos earlier named Nunelucio Alvarado of Sagay City as National Artist for Visual Arts and, posthumously, Teodoro Ledesma Hilado of Silay City, for Theater. Negros Occidental Gov. Eugenio Jose Lacson said both will be honored by the provincial government alongside the top ten real property taxpayers of the province in the […]...
